## Security Review Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or credentials in code
- [ ] No network calls introduced (local-only is a core promise)
- [ ] Audio data is not persisted to disk (unless user opts in)
- [ ] IPC socket has appropriate file permissions (0600)
- [ ] Dependencies audited (no unnecessary packages)
- [ ] No eval/exec on untrusted input
- [ ] Model files loaded from trusted paths only
